world-preview-unofficial.settings.title: World Preview Settings
world-preview-unofficial.settings.genera: General
General World Preview settings
Number of biome sampling threads: %s

Higher numbers speed up the preview.

However, using §lALL§r available threads may cause freezing.
Sample all y-layers all at once

When disabled, only the currently visible y-layer is sampled, instead of fully sampling all y-layers.

Sampling only a single layer is initially faster, but will make scrolling through the y-layers less seamless.
Sample adjacent y-layers in the background

When enabled, neighboring y-layers are sampled in the background once the currently active layer is fully sampled.

Background sampling stops when §lALL§r layers have been sampled.

This option has no effect when all y-layers are sampled all at once.
Sample for structures

Whether to check if a structure is §lLIKELY§r to start in a chunk.

Please note that these results may not be 100% accurate due to the complex nature of structure placement.

§6MODERATE performance impact§r
More translations
Translations added by the port author. Machine translation was used and may be inaccurate. This option has no effect when English is used.
Translation language
Follow game language
Sample for height

Whether to generate a heightmap for the dimension

§cHIGH performance impact§r
Sample y-intersections

Whether to sample the locations of opaque and air blocks, to highlight caves and mountains.

This is done §lBEFORE§r the world is carved, so this will be inaccurate!

§cHIGH performance impact§r
Store raw noise

Whether to store the raw noise values used to determine the biome.

Enabling this option should not reduce performance, however, it will increase the RAM usage and size on disk when caching is enabled.
